decisions.rationale: All five supported populated PermissionMode.NONE plans omit user_permission in the immutable pinned server, while the candidate requires it. This blocks every intended guarded plan/action route. A split closed schema for null and populated plans is local, preserves default deny, and is substantially safer than leaving the supported workflow unusable.
decisions.smallest_fix: Represent the exact eleven-key all-null plan envelope and exact ten-key populated PermissionMode.NONE envelope separately, admit only those closed shapes, and preserve rejection of partial or unknown fields.

decisions.rationale: The candidate can durably publish a normal result naming a requested transition before validating the dynamic route payload. Moving validation ahead of the normal immutable result write is a small ordering change that prevents false transition evidence without widening any route.
decisions.smallest_fix: Validate the parsed route or plan payload before writing the normal session-result artifact, so malformed dynamic output can never be retained as a successful transition.

decisions.rationale: A literal PINNED_SERVER_SOURCE assertion and pinned commit identify the launched child but do not prove why it failed. Without closed attribution evidence, target, fixture, operator, environment, hardware-absence, or unknown failures could be laundered into the authorized limitation path. A bounded immutable attribution record closes only that exceptional boundary.
decisions.smallest_fix: Require a closed hash-bound attribution artifact linking the raw failure to the immutable pinned source or deterministic signature and containing evidence-backed exclusions for every non-server and unknown attribution class before publishing AUTHORIZED_SERVER_LIMITATION.

decisions.rationale: Identity-only substitute artifacts can claim coverage even when the assigned work never ran or failed. Requiring an exact C3-HARNESS execution/completion reference and PASS result is contained to the exceptional path and does not convert substitute coverage into physical certification.
decisions.smallest_fix: Extend the closed substitute-result artifact with a hash-bound C3-HARNESS execution/completion reference and exact PASS outcome, reject missing or failed execution, and retain physical_certification.status as NOT_CERTIFIED.
